title: Exclude pharma and medical companies everywhere, not just in automatic intake?
detail: On 2026-10-23 you said no pharma or medical companies. That rule is in the automatic intake filter only (PR #58). The AI lanes and the Writer's Never Consider list in forge-policy do not have it, so those can still add pharma/medical jobs.
options: Add to Never Consider in forge-policy (all lanes)
recommended: Add to Never Consider so every lane and the Writer apply it.
action: Answer in chat; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
